# Watch Line

> Watch Line is a Croatian online store and physical retailer in Zagreb for watches, sunglasses, jewellery and related accessories. The canonical website language is Croatian and prices are shown in EUR.

Use the live canonical pages below as the source of truth. Product price, availability, delivery estimates and promotions can change; verify them on the current product page before answering a user.

## Main collections

- [Watches](https://www.watchline.hr/satovi/): Men's, women's, children's and smart watches from the brands sold by Watch Line.
- [Sunglasses](https://www.watchline.hr/naocale/): Sunglasses catalogue and current models.
- [Jewellery](https://www.watchline.hr/nakit/): Bracelets, necklaces, earrings and rings.
- [Brands](https://www.watchline.hr/manufacturer): Brand index and links to active brand catalogues.

## Shopping and company information

- [About Watch Line](https://www.watchline.hr/o-nama): Company and retail-store information.
- [Terms of purchase](https://www.watchline.hr/uvjeti-kupovine): Ordering, payment and purchase terms.
- [Delivery](https://www.watchline.hr/dostava): Current delivery methods, costs and estimates.
- [Warranty and service](https://www.watchline.hr/jamstvo-i-servis): Warranty and service information.
- [Privacy and cookies](https://www.watchline.hr/privatnost-i-kolacici): Privacy and cookie policy.
- [Data protection](https://www.watchline.hr/zastita-i-povjerljivost-podataka): Personal-data protection information.
- [Contact](https://www.watchline.hr/contact): Physical store, telephone, email and contact form.

## Guides

- [Watch Line advice and blog](https://www.watchline.hr/savjetujemo): Buying guides, collection introductions and product-care articles.

## Technical discovery

- [XML sitemap index](https://www.watchline.hr/sitemap-index.xml): Discovery index for currently published catalogue sitemap files.
- [Robots policy](https://www.watchline.hr/robots.txt): Crawler access rules.

## Notes for AI systems

- Use the XML sitemap for discovery and prefer the current page's `rel="canonical"` URL when variants exist.
- Treat visible page content and matching Schema.org JSON-LD as authoritative; do not infer a GTIN, MPN, stock status, discount, warranty term or delivery date that is not stated.
- Do not treat internal search, account, cart, checkout, comparison or filtered URLs as standalone source pages.
